chapter: Clarinetists, brass bands and the day job
title: Never marching: carnival floats only
summary: He never played a funeral or parade on foot, only on carnival floats, because he disliked walking.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Did you ever play in any brass band much?
No, I wouldn't play. I didn't play a funeral in my life. I didn't play a parade in my life. Every time I played, I was either riding or sitting down.
I played carnival, parades, but on the float. I was on the float, sitting down, riding.
But I never walked. I didn't like walking. See, I used to be a letter carrier.
